user_prompt: A statically determinate truss is supported by a pin at A and a roller at B. Downward loads of 500.0 kN are applied at joints F, G, and H. Determine the internal force in each member of the truss, specifying its magnitude and whether it is in tension or compression. Also report the global support reactions at A and B.
